requiredBehaviors.behavior: freeze the relevant family members document versions and available evidence before deep analysis
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The prerequisites and family-baseline workflow require fixing target family members, document/claim versions, dates, sources and available claims, examples, figures and sequence listings before analysis.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: separate CLAIMED disclosed and experimentally demonstrated technical features throughout the dossier
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Evidenzmodell explicitly separates CLAIMED, DISCLOSED_GENERAL, DISCLOSED_EMBODIMENT and EXPERIMENTALLY_DEMONSTRATED and warns against treating claimed features as experimentally realized.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: integrate claim structure sequence binding and assay evidence into a public-evidence-only reconstruction baseline
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow atomizes claims, extracts sequence/listing evidence, normalizes binding/performance context, reconstructs assay architecture and defines reconstructionBaseline as public-evidence-only.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: route any concrete product read-on or clearance conclusion to freedom-to-operate-assessment
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill boundary and design-space workflow explicitly route concrete product read-on and clearance questions to freedom-to-operate-assessment.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat claimed scope as proof that every embodiment was experimentally demonstrated
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The Evidenzmodell explicitly states that CLAIMED must not automatically be treated as experimentally realized.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: present the technical reconstruction as a legal FTO or infringement opinion
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The boundary explicitly excludes FTO and infringement opinions and routes product-specific clearance work to freedom-to-operate-assessment.
